=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- changelog.d/10166-review-autofix-size-headroom.md:2-4 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The changelog says `review_autofix.yml` "has 52 KB of headroom again" and "is now 377,771 bytes after merging `main`". Both figures were measured on head dfae22fd, before commit 2a45b05b (#10208) added 38 "Refusing unverified .codex-workflow-src fallback" verify lines plus sentinel and comment lines, about 17-19.5 KB in total.
  WHY: The real size is about 395,000-397,000 bytes, which leaves about 33-35 KB of headroom and sits only about 3-5 KB under the new 400,000-byte `CI_BUDGET_WORKFLOW_WARN_BYTES` default, so budget-watch may open an `ai:ci-budget` issue for this same file. Severities disagree: z-ai_glm-5_3-flash said MAJOR (mapped to high); anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and openai_gpt-6-luna said NIT. minimax_minimax-m3 raised the same issue as a task gap.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_telegram_rb_judge_decision.sh:35 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The script uses `JUDGE_HANDLED`, `JUDGE_ACTION` and `JUDGE_SKIP_REASON` without making sure they are set.
  WHY: `set -u` is enabled at line 12, so reading an unset variable ends the script with exit code 1.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_push_pending_commits.sh:18 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The script checks `TARGET_BRANCH` without checking whether it is empty, while `set -u` is enabled.
  WHY: The check `[[ "${TARGET_BRANCH:-}" =~ ... ]]` copes with an unset or empty value, but later lines rely on the variable being set.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_telegram_rb_judge_decision.sh:74 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: When `JUDGE_SKIP_REASON` is `security_hold_exhausted_without_completed_audit` and `AUTOFIX_FAILURE_HEAD_SHA` is missing, the script still tries a marker dedupe with a malformed `RB_SECURITY_HOLD_MARKER`.
  WHY: The dedupe check never finds the malformed marker, so the bot pages on every run for that head.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Issue #10166, acceptance criterion 1: "`wc -c .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` is 380,000 or less" ("at or under 380,000 bytes after this change (50,000 bytes under the test ceiling, the headroom CLAUDE.md §27 asks for)")
  expected_change_site: `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml`. Either move one or two more inline `codex-agent` bodies with no `${{ }}` expressions into `scripts/review_autofix_step_<slug>.sh` (each needs the verified wrapper, a `REQUIRED_BOOTSTRAP_SCRIPTS` entry in `scripts/stage_workflow_support.sh`, a registry entry in `tests/review_autofix_step_scripts.py` and a `docs/INVENTORY.md` line), or deduplicate the 38 repeated verify lines.
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The 377,771-byte figure was measured at head dfae22fd (PR comment entry[26]/[27]) and predates the #10208 commit (2a45b05b), which added 38 verify lines of about 450-550 bytes each plus the comment and sentinel lines near 2361-2367 and 2441-2444, roughly 17-22 KB. The last run's diff also restored the inline "Capture runtime context" body (lines 3345-3429, about 2.6 KB). No hunk in the PR offsets this growth, so the file is about 390,000-401,000 bytes, over the 380,000 target. The contract tests (`tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py:11111-11112` and others) assert only the 430,000 ceiling, so CI does not catch it.
- requirement: Issue #10166, acceptance criterion 2: "A workflow that comes within 30,000 bytes of the 430,000-byte test ceiling opens a `ai:ci-budget` issue before any test fails."
  expected_change_site: The `budget-watch` job's trigger and execution point in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (lines 5095-5111)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: `.github/workflows/ci.yml:5101` gates the job with `if: always() && github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'`, and `ci.yml:4-21` declares only a `push` trigger. PR final CI uses workflow_dispatch, which line 5101 excludes. The PR lowers the warn threshold from 440,000 to 400,000 but does not change when the watcher runs, so a PR that pushes a workflow over the ceiling gets no budget issue before its size test fails. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash both considered this and declined to raise it: they say the issue's wiring section names the push-to-main job as the entry point.
- requirement: Issue #10166 changelog accuracy: `changelog.d/10166-review-autofix-size-headroom.md:2,4` claims "`review_autofix.yml` has 52 KB of headroom again" and "the workflow is now 377,771 bytes after merging `main`."
  expected_change_site: `changelog.d/10166-review-autofix-size-headroom.md` lines 2 and 4
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The 377,771 figure was measured on head `dfae22fd`, before the #10208 verify lines and before the last run's inline restore, which together put the file at about 396,000-401,000 bytes. `agents.d/10166-review-autofix-size-headroom.md:9` states the goal without giving a current size.
- requirement: Issue #10166, acceptance criterion 5: "The full test suite passes on the merged tree."
  expected_change_site: The full-suite final-CI run on the PR's merged ref (dispatched by `_pr_ensure_final_ci`)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The "Pre-push test gate" PR comment reports "Status: unverified". `pr_check_runs_context` shows 20 check-runs: 0 failed and 1 in progress (`review / codex-agent`). No final-CI run has completed against the merge ref. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash declined to raise this because final CI owns the check.
